newsitem.title: CHILE: Codelco gets $500 million bank loan - Villarzu.
newsitem.headline: Codelco gets $500 million bank loan - Villarzu.

text.p: Chilean state copper company Codelco won a $500 million syndicated loan from private banks with an interest rate at 0.22 percent over Libor, CEO Juan Villarzu said.
Villarzu, in a speech at a seminar, did not say which banks granted the loan but said he believed it was under the best terms ever obtained by a Chilean company.
Codelco has said in the past it will use the loan for copper production investments between now and early in the next decade.
